title: Virginia Regulators Told to Assign Data Center Costs Directly
discussion_signal: The post describes Virginia regulatory pressure to assign transmission costs directly to data centers and other large loads rather than broadly spreading them across ratepayers, while noting disputes over cost-causation and regulatory process.
linked_research_question: Can large-load governance make data centers pay their attributable costs while handling system-wide reliability upgrades fairly?
limits: The post summarizes an active regulatory issue
It does not establish the final tariff or household bill impact
